app_fee.value: International applicants pay a $10 processing fee per application; the application itself is free.
app_fee.quote: A $10 application processing fee is required for all international applicants. | There is no application fee

fee_waiver.value: The $10 international processing fee cannot be waived.
fee_waiver.quote: The fee cannot be waived, transferred to another application, or refunded.

gre_general.value: The university has no GRE requirement, but individual programs may require it (see program records).
gre_general.quote: MTU does not have any Graduate Record Exam (GRE) or Graduate Management Admission Test (GMAT) requirement. | However, individual programs may require one of these examinations.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT minimum 4.5 overall for tests taken on or after January 21, 2026.
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL iBT: Minimum overall score of 4.5 for tests taken on or after January 21, 2026.

also.quote: TOEFL iBT tests taken before January 21, 2026: Minimum overall score of 79.

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic minimum overall band of 6.5.
ielts_min.quote: IELTS: Minimum overall band score of 6.5.

english_waiver.value: India is not on the exempt-country list, so an English-medium degree from India does not waive the test; submit TOEFL or IELTS.
english_waiver.quote: If your home country or country of education is not on our waiver eligible list, you will not qualify for a waiver.

also.quote: Other countries in the following list will not be considered.
